checklist.title: EIP-7927 External Historical Data Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, validate data received from external history sources (e2store, Portal Network, EIP-7801) for correct format and type before processing. Malformed data must be rejected.
executable_checks: Receive block data from Portal Network
Verify RLP structure is valid
Confirm block hash matches expected value
Test with malformed RLP data
Verify rejection of invalid formats
Validate against known block hashes from trusted source
checklist.notes: CRITICAL boundary check. History expiry makes clients dependent on external data sources that must be validated.

checklist.title: EIP-5 CALL Output Bounds Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At EVM call boundary, validate output_start and output_size parameters do not cause integer overflow or exceed memory bounds. Invalid bounds must cause call failure.
executable_checks: Execute CALL with output_start + output_size > 2^256-1
Verify integer overflow is detected and call fails
Test output bounds that exceed current memory size
Confirm memory expansion gas is correctly calculated
Verify output region is properly bounded
checklist.notes: CRITICAL bounds check. Output overflow could enable memory corruption or out-of-bounds writes.

checklist.title: EIP-7702 Type 4 Transaction Format Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At transaction receipt boundary, validate Type 4 (EIP-7702) transactions have correct format including authorization list. Malformed authorization tuples must cause rejection.
executable_checks: Submit Type 4 tx with missing authorization list
Verify rejection
Submit Type 4 tx with malformed authorization tuple
Confirm rejection
Submit Type 4 tx with invalid signature in auth tuple
Verify rejection
Submit valid Type 4 tx
Confirm acceptance
checklist.notes: CRITICAL boundary validation. Type 4 transaction format must be enforced to prevent delegation attacks.

checklist.title: EIP-7702 Authorization Tuple Signature Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify authorization tuples in EIP-7702 transactions contain valid ECDSA signatures from the delegating EOA. Invalid or forged signatures must be rejected before delegation.
executable_checks: Create auth tuple with signature from wrong private key
Verify rejection
Create auth tuple with malformed signature
Confirm rejection
Create auth tuple with valid signature
Verify delegation proceeds
Test signature verification occurs before nonce increment
checklist.notes: CRITICAL cryptographic validation. Invalid signatures would enable unauthorized delegation to attacker-controlled code.

checklist.title: EIP-7702 One-Level Delegation Depth Limit
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify an EOA with delegation code set (0xef0100 prefix) resolves delegation only one level deep. Transitive delegation chains (A→B→C) must not be followed beyond first level.
executable_checks: Create delegation chain: EOA_A delegates to Contract_B, Contract_B delegates to Contract_C
Execute call from EOA_A
Verify only first delegation (A→B) is resolved
Confirm B's delegation to C is NOT followed
Test execution uses B's code, not C's code
Verify no infinite delegation loops are possible
checklist.notes: Delegation depth limit prevents complex attack chains and ensures predictable gas costs.

checklist.title: EIP-7702 Delegation Clearing to EOA State
checklist.detection_procedure: After a delegation is cleared (address set to 0x0...0), verify the account behaves as a standard EOA with no code. All contract-like behavior must cease.
executable_checks: Set up EOA with delegation to contract
Execute delegated call - verify contract code runs
Clear delegation (set address to 0x0)
Attempt delegated call
Verify no code execution (behaves as EOA)
Confirm CodeHash returns EMPTYCODEHASH
checklist.notes: Delegation clearing must completely revert account to EOA state. Residual contract behavior would create security vulnerabilities.

checklist.title: EIP-2364 Fork ID Validation at Peer Connection
checklist.detection_procedure: At peer connection boundary, validate fork ID from remote peer for compatibility. Incompatible fork IDs must trigger immediate disconnection to prevent chain split communication.
executable_checks: Receive handshake with incompatible fork ID
Verify immediate disconnection
Receive handshake with compatible but different chain
Confirm disconnection
Receive handshake with matching fork ID
Verify connection proceeds
Test fork ID calculation includes all historical forks
checklist.notes: CRITICAL network isolation. Fork ID validation prevents connection to incompatible chains, avoiding consensus failures.

checklist.title: EIP-2364 Post-Handshake Fork Compatibility
checklist.detection_procedure: After a successful eth/64 handshake, verify both peers are on compatible fork configurations. Subsequent block exchange must not cause fork-related rejections.
executable_checks: Complete handshake with peer
Exchange blocks from current fork
Verify blocks are accepted (no fork incompatibility)
Test blocks from future scheduled fork
Confirm forward compatibility
Verify fork ID correctly predicts compatibility
checklist.notes: Fork compatibility assurance post-handshake ensures stable peer connections and prevents mid-connection disconnects.

checklist.title: Homestead Rules Enforcement After Activation
checklist.detection_procedure: After the Homestead activation block, verify all Homestead consensus rules are enforced for every subsequent block. No block may revert to pre-Homestead rules.
executable_checks: Process block at Homestead activation (1,150,000)
Verify Homestead rules are active
Process block at activation + 1
Confirm Homestead rules still enforced
Test Homestead-specific features (contract creation gas, difficulty)
Verify no reversion to Frontier rules possible
checklist.notes: CRITICAL fork irreversibility. Homestead activation must be permanent and consistent across all nodes.

checklist.title: EIP-8024 Extended Stack Access Operand Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the immediate operand for extended stack access opcodes (DUP/SWAP with depth > 16) references a valid stack position within current stack depth. Out-of-bounds access must cause exceptional failure.
executable_checks: Execute extended DUP with operand > stack_depth
Verify exceptional failure (all gas consumed)
Execute extended SWAP with operand > stack_depth
Confirm exceptional failure
Test boundary case: operand = stack_depth
Verify success (valid access)
Test operand = stack_depth + 1
Confirm failure
checklist.notes: CRITICAL bounds check. Out-of-bounds stack access could leak internal memory or cause undefined behavior.

checklist.title: EIP-712 Typed Data Structure Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At signature request boundary, validate EIP-712 typed data structure for correct schema, valid types, and proper encoding. Malformed structures must be rejected before signing.
executable_checks: Submit EIP-712 data with invalid type definitions
Verify rejection
Submit data with circular type references
Confirm rejection
Submit data with mismatched domain separator
Verify rejection
Submit valid EIP-712 structure
Confirm acceptance and proper hashing
checklist.notes: EIP-712 structure validation prevents type confusion attacks where malicious dApps trick users into signing unexpected data.

checklist.title: EIP-712 Hash Collision Resistance
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify two structurally different typed data messages never produce the same EIP-712 hash (collision resistance). Hash uniqueness depends on correct type encoding and keccak256 security.
executable_checks: Create two different typed data structures
Compute EIP-712 hashes
Verify hashes are different
Test with very similar structures (one field different)
Confirm different hashes
Verify type encoding prevents collisions
Test domain separator provides replay protection across contracts
checklist.notes: CRITICAL cryptographic property. Hash collisions would enable signature replay attacks across different message types.

checklist.title: EIP-712 Recursive Type Detection
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify recursive struct types are detected and rejected or handled to prevent infinite encoding loops. Circular references must not cause DoS.
executable_checks: Define type A referencing type B, type B referencing type A
Attempt to encode circular structure
Verify rejection or bounded depth handling
Test self-referential types
Confirm infinite loops are prevented
Measure encoding completes in bounded time
checklist.notes: Recursive type handling prevents DoS attacks via infinite encoding loops. Detection must occur before hash computation.

checklist.title: Electra Attestation Format Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At attestation receipt boundary, validate Electra-format attestations for correct structure, valid committee indices, and proper aggregation bits. Malformed attestations must be rejected.
executable_checks: Receive attestation with invalid committee index
Verify rejection
Receive attestation with wrong aggregation bit length
Confirm rejection
Receive attestation with invalid signature
Verify rejection
Receive valid Electra attestation
Confirm acceptance and processing
checklist.notes: CRITICAL boundary validation. Invalid attestations could disrupt consensus or enable slashing attacks.

checklist.title: Electra Pending Deposit Queue Ordering Preservation
checklist.detection_procedure: During the Electra fork transition, verify pending deposit entries preserve their original ordering from the deposit queue. FIFO ordering must be maintained.
executable_checks: Create deposit queue with entries D1, D2, D3
Trigger Electra fork transition
Verify pending deposits maintain order D1, D2, D3
Test processing proceeds in FIFO order
Confirm no reordering or priority changes occur
Verify all deposits are migrated (none lost)
checklist.notes: Queue ordering preservation ensures fairness and prevents deposit processing manipulation during fork upgrade.

checklist.title: EIP-161 Empty Account Deletion After Transaction
checklist.detection_procedure: After transaction execution, verify all empty accounts (zero balance, zero nonce, no code) that were touched during the transaction are removed from state. Untouched empty accounts must remain.
executable_checks: Create transaction that touches empty account A
Execute transaction
Verify account A is deleted from state
Create transaction that creates then empties account B
Confirm account B is deleted at transaction end
Test untouched empty account C remains in state
Verify deletion is atomic with transaction finalization
checklist.notes: Empty account deletion reduces state bloat. Selective deletion (touched only) is critical for EIP-161 correctness.

checklist.title: Capella Execution Engine Withdrawal Trust Assumption
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the execution engine is trusted to honor the withdrawals specified in PayloadAttributes and include them in the produced execution payload. Test withdrawal inclusion and ordering.
executable_checks: Send PayloadAttributes with specific withdrawals
Verify EE includes all withdrawals in payload
Confirm withdrawal ordering matches specification
Test withdrawal amounts are exact
Verify no withdrawals are omitted
Confirm no unauthorized withdrawals are added
checklist.notes: CRITICAL trust assumption. EE trustworthiness is essential for withdrawal security. Compromised EE could steal validator funds.

checklist.title: Capella Withdrawal Credential Change Irreversibility
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify once a validator's withdrawal credentials are changed from BLS (0x00) to execution (0x01), the change is irreversible. No mechanism should allow reverting to BLS credentials.
executable_checks: Change validator credentials from 0x00 to 0x01
Verify change is recorded in state
Attempt to submit another credential change back to 0x00
Confirm rejection (already has 0x01 credentials)
Test no state manipulation can revert credentials
Verify irreversibility is enforced at consensus level
checklist.notes: CRITICAL one-way operation. Credential change irreversibility prevents withdrawal destination manipulation attacks.

checklist.title: Electra Light Client Store Upgrade Precondition
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify LightClientStore upgrade to Electra format is only performed when the store's data is consistent and valid. Invalid or corrupted store state must prevent upgrade.
executable_checks: Attempt upgrade with inconsistent store state
Verify upgrade is blocked
Attempt upgrade with missing finalized header
Confirm rejection
Provide valid, consistent store state
Verify upgrade proceeds successfully
Test upgraded store has correct Merkle branch depths
checklist.notes: Store consistency check prevents corruption during fork upgrade. Invalid upgrade could break light client sync.

checklist.title: ENR Signature Validation Before Acceptance
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify ENR records have a valid signature under the declared identity scheme before being accepted. Invalid or missing signatures must cause rejection.
executable_checks: Receive ENR with invalid signature
Verify rejection
Receive ENR with signature from wrong key
Confirm rejection
Receive ENR with valid v4 signature
Verify acceptance
Test signature verification includes all record fields
Confirm signature covers sequence number
checklist.notes: CRITICAL cryptographic validation. ENR signatures prevent record forgery and ensure node identity authenticity.

checklist.title: ENR Sequence Number Monotonic Increase
checklist.detection_procedure: After updating an ENR, verify the sequence number is strictly greater than the previous record's sequence number. Non-increasing sequence numbers must be rejected.
executable_checks: Create ENR with sequence number N
Update ENR with sequence number N (same)
Verify rejection (not strictly greater)
Update ENR with sequence number N-1 (decrease)
Confirm rejection
Update ENR with sequence number N+1
Verify acceptance
Test sequence number monotonicity across multiple updates
checklist.notes: Sequence number monotonicity prevents replay of old ENR records and ensures clients always use most recent node information.

checklist.title: EIP-7805 Fulu Fork Activation Prerequisite
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the Fulu fork must be fully activated before the EIP-7805 upgrade function is invoked. Attempting upgrade pre-Fulu must fail.
executable_checks: Attempt EIP-7805 upgrade before Fulu activation
Verify upgrade is blocked
Activate Fulu fork
Attempt EIP-7805 upgrade
Confirm upgrade proceeds
Verify upgrade_to_eip7805 checks Fulu state
Test fork version is correctly set post-upgrade
checklist.notes: CRITICAL fork ordering. EIP-7805 depends on Fulu state structure. Upgrading without Fulu would cause state corruption.

checklist.title: EIP-7872 Builder Blob Limit Configuration Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify USER_CONFIGURED_MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK is a positive integer not exceeding the protocol maximum blob count. Invalid values must be rejected at configuration time.
executable_checks: Configure USER_CONFIGURED_MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK = 0
Verify rejection (must be positive)
Configure value > protocol max (e.g., 1000)
Confirm rejection
Configure value = protocol max
Verify acceptance
Test configuration validation occurs at startup
Confirm invalid config prevents builder operation
checklist.notes: Configuration validation prevents builder misconfiguration that could cause block construction failures.

checklist.title: Prague CALL Gas Stipend Reentrancy Prevention
checklist.detection_procedure: Before CALL-like operations, verify the gas remaining exceeds GAS_CALL_STIPEND to prevent reentrancy via gas manipulation. Insufficient gas must cause call failure.
executable_checks: Execute CALL with gas remaining = GAS_CALL_STIPEND
Verify call succeeds
Execute CALL with gas remaining < GAS_CALL_STIPEND
Confirm call fails before execution
Test with DELEGATECALL, STATICCALL
Verify all CALL variants enforce stipend
Confirm reentrancy attack is prevented
checklist.notes: CRITICAL reentrancy protection. Gas stipend check prevents attackers from manipulating gas to enable unexpected reentrancy.

checklist.title: EIP-7927 Historical Data Unavailability Error Responses
checklist.detection_procedure: After history expiry activation, verify clients return appropriate error responses for unavailable historical data rather than incorrect data or timeouts. Error codes must be consistent.
executable_checks: Request pre-merge block data after expiry
Verify specific error response (e.g., -32000 or similar)
Confirm error message indicates data unavailability
Test no incorrect data is returned
Verify no indefinite timeout occurs
Test error response is consistent across clients
checklist.notes: Proper error handling prevents applications from waiting indefinitely or receiving incorrect data when history is unavailable.

checklist.title: EIP-5 CALL Output Bounds Memory Protection
checklist.detection_procedure: After a CALL with output bounds, verify the caller's memory beyond output_start + output_size remains unmodified. Called contract must not write outside bounds.
executable_checks: Set memory region M before CALL
Execute CALL with output_start = 100, output_size = 32
Verify memory [0, 99] unchanged
Verify memory [132, ...] unchanged
Confirm only memory [100, 131] can be modified by callee
Test bounds enforcement prevents overflow attacks
checklist.notes: CRITICAL memory safety. Output bounds prevent called contracts from corrupting caller memory, essential for security isolation.

checklist.title: EIP-7702 Nonce Increment Atomicity with Delegation
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the nonce of a delegating EOA is incremented atomically with the delegation setup to prevent replay. Nonce and delegation must be updated together.
executable_checks: Record EOA nonce before delegation setup
Execute EIP-7702 transaction with authorization
Verify nonce incremented by 1
Confirm delegation code is set
Attempt to replay same authorization with old nonce
Verify replay is blocked
Test atomicity: delegation fails → nonce not incremented
checklist.notes: CRITICAL atomicity. Nonce increment with delegation prevents authorization replay attacks.

checklist.title: EIP-2364 Fork ID Computation Completeness
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the fork ID computation includes all past and known future fork block numbers in chronological order. Missing forks would cause incorrect compatibility detection.
executable_checks: Compute fork ID for network with forks F1, F2, F3
Verify all three forks are included in computation
Test chronological ordering is correct
Add future scheduled fork F4
Confirm F4 is included in fork ID
Verify fork ID changes when new fork is added
Test fork ID determinism across nodes
checklist.notes: CRITICAL fork ID correctness. Incomplete fork lists would cause false positive compatibility detection, enabling chain split communication.

checklist.title: Homestead Fork Upgrade Requirement
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify nodes have upgraded to Homestead-compatible software before block 1,150,000 on mainnet. Non-upgraded nodes must fail to validate Homestead blocks.
executable_checks: Run pre-Homestead client software
Attempt to validate block at height 1,150,000
Verify validation failure (unknown rules)
Upgrade to Homestead client
Re-validate same block
Confirm validation succeeds
Test Homestead rules are enforced post-upgrade
checklist.notes: CRITICAL upgrade requirement. Non-upgraded nodes would fork off the main chain at Homestead activation.

checklist.title: EIP-8024 Extended DUP/SWAP Stack Size Effect
checklist.detection_procedure: After executing a DUP or SWAP with extended depth, verify the stack size changes by exactly the expected amount (+1 for DUP, 0 for SWAP). No other stack effects allowed.
executable_checks: Execute extended DUP (depth 20) with initial stack size 25
Verify stack size increases to 26
Execute extended SWAP (depth 20) with stack size 26
Confirm stack size remains 26
Test DUP always increases by 1
Verify SWAP never changes stack size
Confirm no other side effects on stack
checklist.notes: Stack size effects must be precisely defined. Incorrect effects would break stack depth tracking and enable overflow attacks.

checklist.title: EIP-712 Domain Separator Chain ID Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the domain separator includes the correct chainId matching the chain where the signature will be verified. Mismatched chainId must cause verification failure.
executable_checks: Create EIP-712 signature with chainId = 1 (mainnet)
Attempt verification on chain with chainId = 5 (goerli)
Verify signature verification fails
Create signature with correct chainId for target chain
Confirm verification succeeds
Test domain separator replay protection across chains
checklist.notes: Chain ID validation provides replay protection. Signatures from one chain must not be valid on another chain.

checklist.title: Electra Validator Balance Migration for Compounding Credentials
checklist.detection_procedure: After Electra fork upgrade, verify validators with compounding withdrawal credentials have their balances correctly migrated. Balance accounting must be accurate.
executable_checks: Identify validators with compounding credentials pre-fork
Record balances before Electra upgrade
Execute Electra fork transition
Verify all identified validators have migrated balances
Confirm balance amounts are exact (no loss or gain)
Test balance accessibility post-migration
Verify migration is deterministic across all nodes
checklist.notes: CRITICAL balance migration. Incorrect migration could cause validator fund loss or consensus disagreement.

checklist.title: EIP-161 Prevention of Empty Account Creation
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify no account may transition from non-existent to existent-but-empty (zero nonce, zero balance, no code). Empty accounts can only exist through cleanup lag.
executable_checks: Attempt to create account with zero-value transfer
Verify account is not created (remains non-existent)
Test transfer to non-existent address with value = 0
Confirm no empty account is created
Create account with value > 0
Verify account exists with balance
Confirm empty state is not reachable directly
checklist.notes: Empty account creation prevention reduces state bloat and closes attack vectors for state manipulation.

checklist.title: Capella Execution Engine Withdrawal Inclusion Trust
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the execution engine must be trusted to include all specified withdrawals in the execution payload without omission or reordering. Test withdrawal integrity.
executable_checks: Specify withdrawals W1, W2, W3 in PayloadAttributes
Verify EE includes all three in exact order
Test omission: EE missing W2
Confirm payload validation failure
Test reordering: EE returns W2, W1, W3
Verify validation failure
Confirm withdrawal root check enforces integrity
checklist.notes: CRITICAL EE trust. Withdrawal integrity depends on EE honesty. Validation must detect omissions and reorderings.

checklist.title: Electra Light Client Merkle Branch Depth Correctness
checklist.detection_procedure: After upgrading LightClientStore to Electra, verify all Merkle branches have the correct depth for the new SSZ structure. Incorrect depths would break light client verification.
executable_checks: Upgrade light client store to Electra format
Verify Merkle branches have Electra-defined depths
Test branch verification succeeds with correct depths
Attempt verification with old (pre-Electra) depth
Confirm verification failure
Verify generalized indices match Electra SSZ tree
Test all proof types (finality, optimistic, etc.)
checklist.notes: Merkle branch depth correctness is critical for light client security. Wrong depths would enable invalid state proofs.

checklist.title: ENR Record Size Limit Enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify ENR records do not exceed the 300-byte RLP size limit. Oversized records must be rejected to ensure UDP packet compatibility.
executable_checks: Create ENR with total RLP size = 300 bytes
Verify acceptance
Create ENR with RLP size = 301 bytes
Confirm rejection
Test size calculation includes all fields and signature
Verify RLP encoding overhead is accounted for
Confirm rejection prevents UDP fragmentation issues
checklist.notes: Size limit ensures ENR records fit in single UDP packets, preventing fragmentation and loss in peer discovery.

checklist.title: EIP-7805 Fork Version Uniqueness
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the EIP7805_FORK_VERSION is distinct from all other fork versions to prevent version collision. Duplicate versions would cause fork detection failures.
executable_checks: List all historical fork versions
Verify EIP7805_FORK_VERSION is unique
Test fork digest computation includes EIP-7805 version
Confirm version uniqueness across all upgrade paths
Verify no collision with current or future forks
Test fork identification uses correct version
checklist.notes: CRITICAL version uniqueness. Fork version collisions would break fork digest validation and cause network partitions.

checklist.title: EIP-7872 Builder Block Blob Gas Limit Enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: After applying the blob limit, verify the total blob gas in the constructed block does not exceed MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK. Excess blob gas must cause block construction failure.
executable_checks: Configure USER_CONFIGURED_MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK
Build block approaching blob gas limit
Verify total blob gas <= MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK
Attempt to add blob tx exceeding limit
Confirm tx is not included
Test final block respects protocol maximum
Verify block validation succeeds
checklist.notes: Blob gas limit enforcement prevents protocol violations. Builders must respect both configured and protocol limits.

checklist.title: Prague Transient Storage Transaction Isolation
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify transient storage (TLOAD/TSTORE) is completely cleared at the end of each transaction. No data persists across transactions, ensuring complete isolation.
executable_checks: Execute transaction T1: TSTORE key=K, value=V
Verify TLOAD(K) returns V within T1
Complete transaction T1
Execute transaction T2: TLOAD(K)
Verify TLOAD returns 0 (data cleared)
Test transient storage is isolated per transaction
Confirm no data leakage between transactions
checklist.notes: CRITICAL transaction isolation. Transient storage must not leak data between transactions, essential for security.

checklist.title: Prague SSTORE No-Op Detection
checklist.detection_procedure: After SSTORE with original_value == current_value == new_value, verify no gas refund is issued and no state change occurs. Operation is a pure no-op.
executable_checks: Execute SSTORE setting value V to current value V
Verify no refund is added to refund counter
Confirm storage slot value remains V
Test gas consumption is still charged
Verify no state trie modification occurs
Measure operation is optimized as no-op internally
checklist.notes: No-op SSTORE detection prevents unnecessary state writes and refunds. Optimization improves gas efficiency.

checklist.title: EIP-7927 External Data Validation Against Known Hashes
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify data retrieved from alternate sources (e2store, Portal Network) is validated against known block hashes before being served. Invalid data must be rejected.
executable_checks: Retrieve block data from Portal Network
Compute block hash of retrieved data
Compare with known canonical block hash
Verify match before accepting data
Test with tampered data (hash mismatch)
Confirm rejection
Verify hash validation is mandatory, not optional
checklist.notes: CRITICAL data integrity. Hash validation prevents serving of corrupted or malicious historical data from untrusted sources.

checklist.title: EIP-5 Memory Gas Charging Consistency
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify memory gas charging is consistent whether memory is written by CALL output or by direct MSTORE operations. Gas formula must be identical.
executable_checks: Expand memory to size S via MSTORE
Measure gas cost for expansion
Expand memory to size S via CALL output
Verify identical gas cost
Test memory expansion formula is consistent
Confirm no CALL-specific discount or penalty
Verify gas charging prevents DoS via memory
checklist.notes: Memory gas consistency prevents gas estimation attacks. Different costs for same expansion would enable pricing arbitrage.

checklist.title: EIP-7702 Authorization Chain ID Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the chain_id in the authorization tuple matches the current chain or is 0 (wildcard) for cross-chain authorization. Mismatched chain IDs must cause rejection.
executable_checks: Create authorization with chain_id = current chain
Verify acceptance
Create authorization with chain_id = 0 (wildcard)
Confirm acceptance (cross-chain)
Create authorization with chain_id = different chain
Verify rejection
Test replay protection across chains
checklist.notes: Chain ID validation provides replay protection. Authorizations for wrong chain must be rejected to prevent cross-chain exploits.
